profile.headline: Software Developer at Waterfall Asset Management LLC
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
●	Lead developer on firm’s analytics platform: (1) wrote a custom, in-house fixed-income cashflows modeling engine from scratch (python, numpy); (2) end-to-end microservices; (3) data pipelining and orchestration—responsible for the firm’s stress-testing, cashflow projections, and analytics.
●	Subject matter expert and principal developer of Intex API: modelled CLO/CDO, TruPS, CMBS, etc., extracted deal-, collateral-, and deal-level data (ESG, performance, metrics, etc.) from Intex.
●	Implemented an in-house microservices platform to scale data platform and analytics engine (Python, gRPC, kafka, kubernetes); cut down processing time from 6+ hours to minutes.
●	Oversaw migration accounting data to AWS cloud: (1) created Advent Geneva RSL extracts process (Python), (2) authored and maintained RSL files and Geneva SQL queries, (3) managed consultants to pipeline offline data to AWS (glue, databrew, databricks).
●	Managed a team of offshore developers for the firm’s back- and middle-office needs: various ETL’s, alerts, logging, etc. with bookings, pricing, repos, and margins.
●	Principal developer on and maintainer of in-house GUI tools (Python, Flask, react, react-redux) and automation/orchestration tools (JAMS scheduler, Apache Airflow).

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Developed financial applications using the following technologies:
• Front end: AngularJS, HTML5, Javascript, jQuery, CSS, Bootstrap, Infragistics
• Back end: SQL, C#, ASP.NET, MVC, SSRS reports

positions.title: ETL / C# Developer
positions.description:
• Wrote robust solutions with predictive error handling and asynchronous parallel tasks.
• Parsed and store JSON/XML data from web services and APIs (C# .NET).
• Worked with RESTful services (OAuth, cookie services, HTTPS) for consumption and delivering of encrypted data.
• Ongoing maintenance/QA, and development of C# .NET applications.
• Designed and executed star and snowflake schemas from scratch (MS SQL).
• Designed and developed Tableau dashboards with SQL and Amazon Redshift.

positions.title: Analyst
positions.description:
•	Designed and developed a cash flow forecasting tool with ETL back-end (SSIS, stored procedures, SQL views), web app front-end (MVC, C# ASP.net, HTML5, jQuery) and visualization (Qlikview and Tableau).
• Ongoing maintenance and development of client web-apps (Knockout.js, HTML, CSS, jQuery).
•	Built data mining databases to collect data from different sources: ETL with Excel sheets & flat files like CSV, client API’s via SOAP services, and web forms.
•	Prepared data for extraction and load: data quality assessments and data cleansing (SSIS).
•	Reviewed, analyzed, and reconciled financial transactions; verified database numbers match visualization dashboards.
